title: Networking Fundamentals — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the packet lifecycle from browser keystroke to HTTP 200 payload delivery across Google Edge Anycast and Andromeda SDN.
routing_rationale: Rather than routing traffic across standard public internet transit hops with variable latency, Google Anycast pulls the packet into Google's private fiber network at the nearest edge PoP, routing under Andromeda SDN direct to backend containers.

nodes.label: Browser (URL bar)
nodes.detail: User enters URL; initiates DNS lookup and TCP socket connection.

nodes.label: OS Resolver / Cache
nodes.detail: Checks local resolver cache before sending recursive query to 8.8.8.8.

nodes.label: Anycast Edge PoP
nodes.detail: BGP Anycast routes request to nearest Google Point of Presence worldwide.

nodes.label: Google Front End (GFE)
nodes.detail: Terminates TCP/TLS connection; applies DDoS filtering and HTTP/2 multiplexing.

nodes.label: Backend App Instance
nodes.detail: Private VM receiving decapsulated HTTP request and computing JSON response.

steps.title: Hostname Resolution
steps.action: OS resolver queries 8.8.8.8; receives Anycast VIP 34.120.45.67.
steps.why_traversal: DNS resolution establishes edge destination before socket handshake.

steps.title: BGP Anycast Ingress
steps.action: Browser opens TCP SYN connection to nearest Google Point of Presence.
steps.why_traversal: Pulls packet into Google fiber within 15ms, minimizing public internet jitter.

steps.title: Edge TLS Termination
steps.action: GFE terminates TLS handshake and performs HTTP/2 multiplexing.
steps.why_traversal: Offloads crypto overhead from backend compute nodes.

steps.title: Backend Processing
steps.action: Andromeda delivers packet to backend vNIC for HTTP 200 JSON processing.
steps.why_traversal: Application parses request and streams response back along reverse tunnel.

scenarios.label: PMTUD Blackhole / Packet Drop
scenarios.root_cause: Packet exceeds 1460-byte VPC MTU and DF flag is set while ICMP Fragmentation Needed is blocked.
scenarios.diverted_path: Large payloads are silently dropped in transit without TCP acknowledgment.
scenarios.blast_radius: Large API responses hang indefinitely while small ping packets succeed.
scenarios.recovery: Configure VPC MTU to 1500 or 8896 bytes; allow ICMP Type 3 Code 4 in firewall rules.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
